svg.text: data parallelism, but params · gradients · optimizer state are sharded across the GPUs
All-gather = each GPU's shard travels to every other GPU (watch the strips slide across) → that layer is FULL, computes, then is discarded.
Only ONE layer is full at a time → peak memory ≈ one layer, not the whole model.
Same data-parallel math as `data-parallelism`, a fraction of the memory: its all-reduce = reduce-scatter + all-gather, done per layer.
